name: Mini 14 Ranch Rifle
axis_orientation: muzzle is at the positive end of the axis
operating_principle: The Ruger Mini-14 Ranch Rifle operates on a gas-operated short-stroke fixed piston, rotating bolt principle, where the gas generated by the firing cartridge is used to cycle the action and chamber a new round.

components.description: The barrel group consists of the barrel and related components.
The receiver is the main structural body of the rifle, housing the bolt and other operating components.
The bolt and bolt carrier group are responsible for chambering and extracting the cartridge.
The fire control group includes the trigger, hammer, and safety components.
The feed system consists of the magazine and related components.
The furniture includes the stock, grip, and handguard.
The sights include the front and rear sights, as well as any optic mounts.
The muzzle device includes any components attached to the muzzle of the barrel.
